classifications.name: Cardholder Data
classifications.description: Payment card data subject to PCI-DSS v4.0. Includes primary account numbers (PAN), cardholder name, expiration date, service code, and sensitive authentication data (CVV, PIN).

patterns.description: Luhn algorithm validation for card numbers
Card expiration date MM/YY or MM/YYYY

classifications.name: Personally Identifiable Information
classifications.description: Personal data subject to GDPR, CCPA/CPRA. Includes names, addresses, identifiers, and any data that can directly or indirectly identify a natural person.

patterns.description: Name and address appearing together in the same context

classifications.name: Financial Services Data
classifications.description: Financial data subject to GLBA, BSA/AML, SOX, DORA. Includes account numbers, transaction records, and financial instruments data.

classifications.name: Protected Health Information
classifications.description: Health data subject to HIPAA Security Rule, HITECH. Includes medical records, diagnoses, treatment information, and any individually identifiable health information.

patterns.description: Clinical terms, drug names, procedure codes

classifications.name: Controlled Unclassified Information
classifications.description: Government data subject to CMMC Level 2, NIST 800-171r3. Information that requires safeguarding or dissemination controls pursuant to federal law, regulation, or government-wide policy.

pattern_detection.note: Requires declared classification. CUI markings are organizational, not pattern-detectable.

classifications.name: Material Non-Public Information
classifications.description: Securities data subject to SEC Reg FD, SOX. Non-public information that could influence investment decisions.

pattern_detection.note: Requires declared classification. MNPI is contextual, not pattern-detectable.

classifications.name: Federal Contract Information
classifications.description: Non-public federal contract data subject to CMMC Level 1. Information provided by or generated for the government under contract.

classifications.name: General Business Data
classifications.description: Non-sensitive business data. Baseline controls apply. SOC 2 provides the universal enterprise compliance foundation.

pattern_detection.note: General data — no specific patterns to detect.

classifications.name: Government System Data
classifications.description: Federal system data subject to FedRAMP, FISMA. Data processed, stored, or transmitted by federal information systems.

classifications.name: AI Training / Model Data
classifications.description: AI system data subject to EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF. Includes training datasets, model weights, evaluation data, and AI system operational parameters.

pattern_detection.note: Requires declared classification. AI data is domain-specific, not pattern-detectable.

classifications.name: Export-Controlled Data
classifications.description: Defense and dual-use data subject to ITAR, EAR. Technical data and defense articles controlled under export regulations.

classifications.name: Critical Infrastructure OT Data
classifications.description: SCADA/ICS data subject to NERC CIP, NIS2. Operational technology data from critical infrastructure sectors.

classifications.name: Children's Data
classifications.description: Data from minors subject to COPPA, GDPR Art. 8, FERPA. Personal information collected from children under 13 (COPPA) or 16 (GDPR).

pattern_detection.note: Requires declared classification. Age determination is contextual.

classifications.name: Biometric Data
classifications.description: Biometric identifiers subject to BIPA, GDPR Art. 9, EU AI Act. Fingerprints, facial geometry, voiceprints, retinal scans, and other biometric identifiers.

pattern_detection.note: Requires declared classification. Biometric data formats are domain-specific.

classifications.name: Legal Privileged Data
classifications.description: Attorney-client privileged communications, work product. Data protected by legal privilege doctrines.

pattern_detection.note: Requires declared classification. Legal privilege is contextual.

classifications.name: Trade Secrets & Proprietary Data
classifications.description: Trade secrets, proprietary algorithms, competitive intelligence. Commercially valuable information deriving value from secrecy.

pattern_detection.note: Requires declared classification. Trade secret identification is organizational.
